title: Telangana Govt Announces New Infrastructure Project for Hyderabad
description: The state government has announced a massive high-speed metro corridor connecting Hitec City and the Airport.
ai_summary: Hyderabad to get new high-speed metro corridor. Project links Hitec City to Airport for seamless travel.

title: Heatwave Alert: IMD Issues Red Warning for Telangana Districts
description: Temperature expected to cross 45°C in several parts of the state. Citizens advised to stay indoors.
ai_summary: Red alert issued for heatwave in Telangana. Temperatures to exceed 45°C; avoid outdoor activities.
